name: VerifySender
description: Read-only. Checks whether an email address is a registered accounts-payable contact (CustomerContacts flagged isApContact – a Priority row or one added here, source נוסף אצלנו) of a customer. מאומת = exact address of an isApContact contact of that customer (or, with no customer given, of exactly one customer); לבדיקה = the address is a contact of the customer not flagged isApContact, belongs to a different customer, or only the domain matches a contact; לא מאומת = no match. A statement or open-debts PDF may go only to a מאומת sender. Writes nothing.

customerCode.description: Customer the email is about, when known
